scope.looks: global driver loop in the date range; look events carry no case identity

cost.policy: trend per actor, role, model, quest and ask; no numeric ceiling

leadTime.filedToDone: not recorded: quests.filed and done timestamp pairs
leadTime.doneToLine: not recorded: quest done and landing line removal timestamp pairs

perQuest.tokens: not recorded: usage-history turns in the selected range and scope

cost.total: not recorded: usage-history turns in the selected range and scope

perAsk.tokens: not recorded: usage-history turns in the selected range and scope

cost.modelAllocation: a multi-model turn is a joint total; the record does not allocate its tokens between models

receipts.firstPass: not recorded: merge queue records; pass --merge-queue <local/merge-queue.json>
receipts.mergeFlow: not recorded: merge run records; pass --merge-record <local/merge-record.jsonl>

leftovers.sessionBranchesPresent: not recorded: case branch identity in landing records or session branch name
leftovers.staleWorktrees: not recorded: git worktree prunable inventory correlated with case sessions

askDaoris.conversations: not recorded: usage-history Ask Daoris turns in range
askDaoris.turns: not recorded: usage-history Ask Daoris turns in range
askDaoris.tokens: not recorded: usage-history turns in the selected range and scope

lyntai.cited: not recorded: the handback or session log of memory entry ids cited by a result
lyntai.latencyMs: not recorded: memory tool call start and completion timestamp pairs
lyntai.latencyNote: a call's first and last event in the session stream: includes any permission wait; the connector's own log (the mcp log) records only app.started and app.stopped

stages.done: not recorded: quest_log done.at or quest submission.at
stages.submitted: not recorded: quest_log submitted.at or quest submission.at
stages.held: not recorded: workflow hold entry timestamp; quest submitted is readiness, not a hold
stages.questAccepted: not recorded: quest_log accepted.at or quest.accepted (departure/evidence yes, separate from workflow Accept)
stages.accepted: not recorded: workflow review Accept completion timestamp; quest.accepted is a different yes
stages.pushed: not recorded: push completion timestamp; landings.pushed/pushedTip records no clock
stages.prMerged: not recorded: landings pullRequestState.at when state=merged
stages.released: not recorded: plugin release node completion timestamp bound to this quest and commit in workflow observations; built-in release cleans a tree

lifecycle.stageClock: first retained clock per stage; transitions retain repeated takes, submissions and reopens
lifecycle.firstCommitClock: git first-parent committer timestamp; the session tree must still be readable

elapsedMs.firstCommitToDone: not recorded: session first commit clock and quest done.at
elapsedMs.doneToHeld: not recorded: workflow hold entry timestamp
elapsedMs.doneToAccepted: not recorded: quest done and acceptance timestamps
elapsedMs.doneToQuestAccepted: not recorded: quest done and departure/evidence yes timestamps
elapsedMs.acceptedToLanded: not recorded: acceptance and landing timestamps
elapsedMs.doneToLanded: not recorded: quest done and landing timestamps
elapsedMs.pushedToPrMerged: not recorded: push and PR merge completion timestamps

workflow.ended: not recorded: workflows/units run ended record

steps.attempt: not recorded: workflow node attempt number
steps.attemptState: not recorded: workflow dispatched attempt state

steps.waitMs: not recorded: workflow ready timestamp (person-again history or retry due) and attempt start
steps.workMs: not recorded: workflow attempt outcome timestamp beside recordedAt
steps.workClock: node history clearing an active attempt; otherwise missing
steps.holdReason: not recorded: workflow node holds reason
steps.waiter: not recorded: workflow wait owner identity; status.holds is a reason, not a person
steps.clearedBy: not recorded: workflow hold-clear actor in node history or attempt.resolution
steps.holdObservedAt: not recorded: workflow.held log with node and session/run, or active pressed review/go-ahead status.since
steps.ageMs: not recorded: workflow.held first observation timestamp; status.since clocks the attempt, not the hold
